context.text: Incumbent Lizzie Pannill Fletcher (D) ran unopposed in the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary. Alexander Hale won a May 26, 2026 Republican primary runoff against Tina Blum Cohen, 64.3% to 35.7%. As of September 2026, forecasters (Cook Political Report, Decision Desk HQ, Inside Elections, Sabato's Crystal Ball) rated the general election Solid/Safe Democratic.

candidates.name: Lizzie Pannill Fletcher

summary.text: Lizzie Pannill Fletcher is the Democratic incumbent U.S. Representative for Texas's 7th Congressional District, a Houston lawyer.

background.text: Born and raised in Houston, Texas; graduated from St. John's School, earned a bachelor's degree in history from Kenyon College, and a J.D. from William & Mary Law School.
Worked as a lawyer before being elected to Congress; co-founded Planned Parenthood Young Leaders in 2000.
Serves as a board member of Writers in the Schools and the Open Dance Project.

record.text: Serves on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce, including the Health Subcommittee and the Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee, in the 2025–2026 Congress.

candidates.name: Espoir Ngabo
candidates.ballotNote: Won the Green Party convention nomination

summary.text: Espoir Ngabo is an information-technology professional running as the Green Party nominee for Texas's 7th Congressional District on a platform funded with no corporate money.

background.text: Built a nearly decade-long career in information technology, supporting business systems and infrastructure.
Based in Houston and connected to the Alief, Sharpstown, and Gulfton communities.

priorities.text: Says his campaign takes zero corporate money and is "powered by everyday people."
Calls for stronger flood protection and disaster preparedness, reliable public transit, and safer roads and sidewalks in the district.

positions.summary: Supports a $25 federal minimum wage indexed to the cost of living.
positions.quote: a $25 federal minimum wage that keeps up with the cost of living

positions.summary: Supports a single-payer healthcare system covering everyone.
positions.quote: healthcare for everyone through a single-payer system
